title: Nayrïr Wilajj Envidiasisaw warantasïna
intro: Jaqinakan nayrïr urunakapat amuytʼañäni, uraqpachax mä familiakïskänwa. Jumax uñjtawa kunjams pä ofrendanakax Allah nayraqatan uchatäski — maynix katuqatawa, maynix janiw satawa. Envidiasiñax chuyman saphintata, ukat mä amenazax colerat jiskʼat arsu. Kunatix jutïrin utjkani ukax wiñayatakiw sarnaqäwinx mä chimpu jaytani, ukat mä jisk’a jamach’ix yatichiriruw tukuni.
clues: Nayajj aka Oraqen nayrïr familiat jutirïtwa.
Nayax Allah-ar mä ofrenda uñacht’ayawayta, ukampis nayanx janiw katuqatäkänti mayni ofrendax katuqatäkchisa.
Envidiasisaw arsüna ukat jiwañar aptʼasiñwa ajjsarayäyäta.
Aka Oraqenjja, nayrïr jan cheqapar jiwayañwa lurawayta.
Mä cuervo uñjta, kunjamsa mä cuerpo imantaspa uk uñachtʼayañatakejj oraqe chʼoqtʼasiski.
Nayax arrepentisiñampiw qhiparawayta ukat kuntï amparanakajax lurawaykta ukat chhaqhirinakat maynïriruw tukuwayta.

identity.label: ¿Khitis nayajja?
options: Qabil (Caín), Adán chachan wawapa
Samiri, uka waka qallu lurayiri
Namrud, tirano jupax Ibrahim jupampiw ch’axwawayxi
Azar, idolonak lurayiri
Kan'an, umamp chhaqhat Nuh yuqapa

trial.answer: Mä jilapar envidiasisaw jiwayaña, ofrenda jan iyawsatapat

outcome.answer: Arrepentisiñaruw tukuwayi ukat chhaqhirinaka taypinwa jikxatasïna

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
